limit is reached.                                                                         Evidence

ducted a systematic comparison of Android input-generation tools
and highlighted both the promise and limitations of automated                      8    Conclusion
mobile testing. Prior work has proposed a variety of techniques                    In this paper, we present PropGen, an automated approach for
to automatically explore app GUIs and generate event sequences                     constructing properties of mobile apps. By exploring app function-
for detecting crash bugs [9, 19, 33, 35, 37, 50, 61, 64]. For exam-                alities and deriving properties from behavioral evidence, PropGen
ple, Sapienz [37] uses multi-objective search to generate event se-                reduces the need for manual property specification. We further
quences for improving coverage and exposing crashes. To find non-                  propose a feedback-driven refinement technique to refine impre-
crash functional bugs, most of prior work [1, 45, 51, 53, 54, 63, 72, 77]          cise properties exposed during testing. Experiments on real-world
designs automated oracles to overcome the oracle problem. How-                     Android apps show that PropGen can effectively generate valid
ever, these work are limited to specific types of functional bugs                  executable properties. These results demonstrate the practical value
(e.g., data losses [1, 45, 77]). Some work leverages LLM to analyze                of automated property construction for mobile app property-based
GUI pages during exploration to find data inconsistency bugs [20],                 testing.
functional bugs [34], or inconsistencies between app design and
implementation [31].                                                               9    Data Availability
